story.iWant: to be able to log out of my account
story.soThat: I can securely end my session and protect my private information on a shared device.
story.tasks: - Task 1: Add a "Logout" button/menu item to a user profile `DropdownMenu` in the main navigation UI. (AC: 1) - Task 2: Implement the `signOut` method in `AuthManager` to call `supabase.auth.signOut()`. (AC: 2) - Task 3: Connect the UI "Logout" button to the `AuthManager.signOut` method. (AC: 2) - Task 4: On successful sign out, ensure the global `zustand` auth state is cleared. (AC: 3) - Task 5: Implement a redirect to the login page after the sign-out process is complete. (AC: 4) - Task 6: Write a unit test for the `AuthManager.signOut` method. - Task 7: Write an E2E test to confirm a logged-in user can log out and can no longer access a protected route like `/dashboard`. (AC: 5)

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: - AC 1: Given I am logged into the application, Then a "Logout" button or menu item must be clearly visible and accessible (e.g., within a user profile dropdown in the main navigation). - AC 2: Given I click the "Logout" button, When the action is triggered, Then the client-side `AuthManager.signOut()` function must be invoked. - AC 3: Given the `signOut` call to Supabase is successful, Then the user's session (including any JWT stored in the client) must be cleared. - AC 4: Given I have successfully logged out, When the application navigates, Then I must be redirected to the public home page or the login page. - AC 5: Given I have logged out, Then I must not be able to access any protected routes (e.g., `/dashboard`) without logging in again.

doc.title: AI-Powered Personal Study Planner - Solution Architecture
doc.snippet: Supabase Auth (GoTrue) is the authentication service responsible for managing user sign-up, login, password resets, and issuing JWTs for secure API access.

doc.title: UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: The "Logout" button should be implemented using the standard Shadcn UI component library, likely as part of a `DropdownMenu` associated with a user avatar.

story-context.constraints: - All authentication logic must be handled through the `AuthManager` client-side service. - The implementation must use the `supabase.auth.signOut()` method. - The global `zustand` authentication state must be cleared upon successful logout. - The user must be redirected to a public page after logging out.

interface.name: IAuthManager

tests.standards: Use a testing framework like Cypress or Playwright for E2E tests. Create unit tests for services like AuthManager, mocking external calls. Test UI components in isolation.
tests.locations: - Unit/Service Tests: `src/services/__tests__/` - Component Tests: `src/components/__tests__/` - E2E Tests: `cypress/e2e/`
tests.ideas: - (AC 2) Unit test the `AuthManager.signOut` method to ensure it calls the Supabase client correctly and clears local state. - (AC 1) Component test for the user profile dropdown to ensure the "Logout" button is present and clickable. - (AC 4, 5) E2E test: Log in, then click the logout button, and verify that the user is redirected to the login page and can no longer access `/dashboard`.
